notes: Frame follows the 2026-27 DU Undergraduate Bulletin BS in Computer Science core (COMP 1201-1203 with 1351-1353, 2300, 2370, 2361, 2362, 2381, plus 24 credits of 3000-level breadth). This is the new core numbering, so most courses have little public syllabus history. DU is the private University of Denver, not CU Denver (CSCI codes).
